title: 480. Queue Reconstruction by Height

examples.explanation: Sorting tall-first then slotting each person at their k index rebuilds the line.
Shorter people slide into the gaps left by taller ones already placed.

hints: Order people by height descending, breaking ties by k ascending.
Insert each person at index k of the growing line; taller people already placed are exactly the ones each k counts.
Insertion into a list gives O(n^2) time, fine for n up to 2000.
